name: cortico-world-pet-draw
description: Cortico World: the desktop pet draws 1-4 small 512x512 pictures in a style fixed by its persona (a child draws crayon doodles), pops one up, asks how it went, saves them by rating, and answers quota questions in pictures. Pictures only: no video, no HD, no photo-real output.

zh.description: 让桌宠按自己的人设画 512×512 的小画：小孩子就画蜡笔涂鸦，别的性格各有笔触。画完自动弹图、问评价，按评价收进画夹；只画图，不生成视频和高清图。

en.description: Lets the desktop pet draw small 512x512 pictures in the style its persona would use, pop one up, ask for a rating and file it into the drawing folder. Pictures only, never video or HD.
